tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: Match your requirements (e.g. ['whatsapp', 'booking', 'multilingual']) against the whole Growaify catalogue - services, templates and the 489-item micro catalogue - and return matches with pricing and a direct buy link. No API key required.

tools.name: create_binding_quote
tools.description: Generate a binding, deterministic quote with agent discount pricing and wholesale volume tiers. Quote is valid for 7 days. AUTH: requires an API key - get one instantly with POST https://growaify.com/api/v1/agents/register using name and purpose fields. No email needed. Send it as the X-API-Key head

tools.name: purchase_service
tools.description: Place an idempotent commercial order from a binding quote. Payment settles via PayPal, x402 (USDC on Base), or Agent Wallet. AUTH: requires an API key - get one instantly with POST https://growaify.com/api/v1/agents/register using name and purpose fields. No email needed. Send it as the X-API-Key he

tools.name: track_order_telemetry
tools.description: Query order state, execution progress (0-100%), and provisioned digital deliverables with SHA-256 checksums.

tools.name: query_trust_and_sla
tools.description: Inspect cryptographic checksum policy, refund policies, payment rails, and trust metadata for the platform. No API key required - read this before you decide to buy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_binding_quote, purchase_service · Private data: discover_capabilities, create_binding_quote, purchase_service, query_trust_and_sla · Public sink: create_binding_quote, purchase_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_binding_quote, purchase_service · Private data: discover_capabilities, create_binding_quote, purchase_service, query_trust_and_sla · Public sink: create_binding_quote, purchase_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
